wants.topic: Domestic drama & daily life struggles resolved by divine intervention (Maa Durga)
wants.evidence: GuruVaani Studio's video about an old woman making Maa Durga do chores hit 322.13x vsNormal, and stepmother drama stories hit 45.96x-63.54x vsNormal.

wants.topic: High-curiosity Puranic secrets and untold post-event consequences
wants.evidence: Mystery of the World achieved 44.91x with Markandeya Purana secrets and 14.66x with 'which son was born after Indra fooled Ahalya'.

wants.topic: Modern saint miracle stories framed as divine avatars (Neem Karoli Baba)
wants.evidence: Anant Gatha scored 41.38x and 20.2x vsNormal with 'Neem Karoli Baba: Hanuman Ansh Avtar' cinematic films.

wants.topic: 'Full Movie' mega-edits consolidating complete epics into one long video
wants.evidence: Rasiya Films got 20.47x vsNormal with 'Ramayana Full Movie in 1 Video', and Anant Gatha got 31.53x with their Ramayan 4K film.

wants.topic: Lesser-known regional folk kathas (e.g., Adhaiya Brahmana Katha)
wants.evidence: Rasiya Films achieved 10.9x and 10.47x vsNormal on videos specifically covering Adhaiya Brahmana.
